backgrounds.name: Artisan
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 32 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, 2 Pouches and Artisan's Tools of a kind you are proficient with.

backgrounds.name: Charlatan
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 15 GP plus Fine Clothes, a Costume and a Forgery Kit.

backgrounds.name: Entertainer
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 11 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, Perfume, a Mirror, 2 Costumes and a Musical Instrument of a kind you are proficient with.

backgrounds.name: Farmer
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 30 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, a Shovel, an Iron Pot, a Healer's Kit, Carpenter's Tools and a Sickle.

backgrounds.name: Guard
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 12 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, a Quiver, Manacles, a Hooded Lantern, a Gaming Set of a kind you are proficient with, 20 Bolts, a Light Crossbow and a Spear.

backgrounds.name: Guide
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 3 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, a Tent, a Quiver, a Bedroll, Cartographer's Tools, 20 Arrows and a Shortbow.

backgrounds.name: Hermit
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 16 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, 3 flasks of Oil, a Lamp, a Book on philosophy, a Bedroll, an Herbalism Kit and a Quarterstaff.

backgrounds.name: Merchant
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 22 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, 2 Pouches and Navigator's Tools.

backgrounds.name: Noble
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 29 GP plus Perfume, Fine Clothes and a Gaming Set of a kind you are proficient with.

backgrounds.name: Sailor
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 20 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, Rope, Navigator's Tools and a Dagger.

backgrounds.name: Scribe
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 23 GP plus 12 sheets of Parchment, 3 flasks of Oil, a Lamp, Fine Clothes and Calligrapher's Supplies.

backgrounds.name: Wayfarer
equipment: Either take 50 GP, or start with 16 GP plus Traveler's Clothes, 2 Pouches, a Bedroll, a Gaming Set of any kind, Thieves' Tools and 2 Daggers.

feats.name: Crafter
feats.desc: Gain proficiency with three of the eight tool kinds below; nonmagical purchases cost you 20 percent less. On completing a long rest, you may make one listed item with tools you possess and are proficient with; it falls apart when your next long rest ends. Carpenter's tools can make a torch or ladder; leatherworker's tools a pouch, map or scroll case, or crossbow bolt case; mason's tools a block and tackle; potter's tools a lamp or jug; smith's tools an iron pot, grappling hook, caltrops, bucket or ball bearings; tinker's tools a tinderbox, shovel or bell; weaver's tools a tent, net, rope or basket; woodcarver's tools a quarterstaff, greatclub or club.

feats.name: Healer
feats.desc: Take the Utilize action and spend one use of a healer's kit to treat a creature within 5 feet. If it spends one Hit Point Die, roll that die and add your proficiency bonus to find how many hit points it recovers. When your healing spell or this treatment rolls a 1 on a healing die, you may reroll that die once and keep the replacement result.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.desc: Your pool of Luck Points holds as many points as your proficiency bonus, and a long rest refills it. Spend 1 point when rolling a D20 Test to roll with advantage. Alternatively, spend 1 point when a creature rolls an attack against you to give that roll disadvantage.

feats.name: Musician
feats.desc: Choose three musical instruments to gain proficiency with. At the end of a short or long rest, you may perform on an instrument you are proficient with to grant Heroic Inspiration to listening allies. You can choose as many allies as your proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
feats.desc: Your damaging Unarmed Strikes can use 1d4 plus your Strength modifier as bludgeoning damage. You may reroll any unarmed damage die showing 1 once, keeping its replacement result. You are proficient with improvised weapons. Once on your turn, an Unarmed Strike that hits during your Attack action can also push its target 5 feet away while dealing damage.

feats.name: Tough
feats.desc: Taking this feat adds 2 hit points per current character level to your hit point maximum. Each later character level adds another 2 hit points to that maximum.
